name: concepts-readroom-explore/dream
refs: THE POD (project-owned game art): a wild seed pod, slate-blue with a round coral cap, pale vertical ribs and coral dots, standing on a small turned wooden dish. Keep its design exactly wherever the pod appears; never make it a jar, a vase, a lantern of metal, or an egg of another design.

THE CREATURE (project-owned game art): the Loika the pod will become: a small round charcoal creature with a cream belly and muzzle, amber eyes, four stubby legs with pale toes and three green leaves on its head. Keep its design exactly; never invent another creature.

THE PAINTED LANGUAGE (one of our signed Vivarium room paintings, project-owned): its matte painterly miniature rendering, soft occlusion, warm golden light, cosy palette. Take the treatment and the warmth only, none of its objects.
prompt:
Paint the WHOLE screen of a cosy handheld creature-keeping game, 16:9, a mood-and-layout thumbnail for a concept: the READING ROOM, where the player opens up a wild pod (a seed pod with a creature's genome sleeping inside) one surprise at a time. The feeling: a pod is RICH IN SURPRISES, there is more inside than you can see, and each read brings one out into the light. CONCEPT: THE DREAM. The grey creature sleeps curled around its pod, and its dreams rise from the pod as soft bubbles, each holding one surprise; the player catches a bubble and the dream comes true on the creature. COMPOSITION: in the lower third, big, on a round woven rug by a warm hearth glow, the Loika lies asleep curled around the pod, which rests against its belly like an egg being kept warm, slate-blue, coral cap, glowing softly from within. The creature is mostly grey fog with only its cream belly and one russet patch on its back painted in colour. From the pod's cap, a stream of soft round DREAM BUBBLES rises up through the upper two thirds of the dark cosy room, drifting and wobbling, each bubble lit from inside with a different soft picture: a lock of russet fur, an amber eye, pale toes, a leaf, a curl of tail, a pair of ears; the highest ones large and near, the lowest small and just leaving the pod. One bubble is bursting into a shower of warm sparks that fall toward the creature's back. A dark warm plaster wall with a small round window of night sky, a stool, a mug, nothing else.
LIGHT AND FINISH: warm key light, warm bounce, soft ambient occlusion, soft contact shadows. Matte, hand-painted miniature finish like the painted reference, cosy and warm, real depth; low saturation everywhere except the pod's inner light and the surprises. No gloss, no chrome, no plastic, no neon, no sci-fi interface, no holograms, nothing childish.
NO text, letters, digits, numbers, logos, buttons, panels, boxes or icons anywhere (the game types its words later). No frame, no border, no vignette; the picture fills the canvas edge to edge.
